Even after joining the company, whenever I tried to give my opinion in a meeting, my mind went blank. Then a senior colleague gave me some advice: "There's no need to try to speak perfectly. Just decide on one thing you want to get across." Since then, I make a point of writing down the main thing I want to say before I speak. Strangely, that alone made me feel much more relaxed.
